# `bubbles`

Helper: `bubbles({ text, time, mine }, ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap; in the agent-admin session detail WJ16 it is the body of `AgentChatPane`: a `card` with the customer / bot bubbles) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCardLine` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Chat bubbles with optional sender name, text, time line, optional italic note. Customer left (tile), own or bot right (info-soft).

## Variants

- `mine: true` right and tinted

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile, info-soft, ink, ink-soft, radius-card

## Do

- Show the time under the text
- In the agent chat the customer is left and the bot right

## Don't

- Do not use it for a notice

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Max width 94%.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Care-team messages, left; `mine: true` = the patient's message, right and tinted. Time line under the text. `who` (sender name over the text) and `note` (small italic line under it) are for the agent-admin chat (WJ16): the customer on the left, the bot (`mine: true`) on the right
